_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
v3.2.119

Matched SysID checks a sealed observation after every short valve probe for pulses emerging at the new cuff pressure. Original measurement endpoints and open duration are retained; unresolved pulse/trend fits are rejected and accepted device tuning remains unchanged. Fresh quiet post-probe evidence avoids repeating the next full preparation wait.

Validated by 355 focused tests on this branch and a 960-case synthetic challenge: zero accepted rate errors above 0.2 mmHg/s, 192/192 pulse-free cases retained. GUI layout and smoke checks pass. This does not certify cuff transfer, pulses confined to the open interval, or 1000-device reproducibility. Firmware is unchanged.
